model_system: 2D kagome-lattice AV3Sb5 effective 3dXZ (b3g) orbital model with 4x3-site supercell including 3Q bond order and 3Q loop-current order

key_params.orbitals: single effective dXZ (b3g) orbital on kagome A/B/C sublattices
key_params.magnetic_free_energy: Delta F = -3 h_z M_orb with emergent trilinear term -3 m1 h_z eta·phi

headline_claim: Tiny magnetic field of order 1 T can align/stabilize the 3Q chiral current order via orbital magnetization, with M_orb strongly enhanced by coexistence with bond order and scaling as M_orb ∝ eta^3 (current only) or M_orb ∝ eta (with finite phi).
replication_difficulty: medium — effective tight-binding calculation is straightforward, but reproducing the paper’s GL coefficients/current-bond-field coupling requires implementing the 12-band folded-zone model and orbital-magnetization formula carefully.
